description: This file defines the 'ModifyAttributeStrategy' class, which implements the logic for handling the 'ModifyAttribute' command within a system managing 'things'. It includes methods for applying the command, creating modification or creation results, and managing entity tags, focusing on updating attributes of 'Thing' objects.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class responsible for handling 'ModifyAttribute' commands, applying changes to 'Thing' objects, and producing relevant events and responses.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the modify attribute command on a 'Thing', either modifying an existing attribute or creating a new one, after size validation.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Constructs a result representing a modification event for an existing attribute.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Constructs a result representing the creation of a new attribute.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the attribute before modification, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the entity tag for the attribute after modification.
